observations: Photos 0 and 1 show one wooden pallet lying on concrete, with worn slats and red paint on a bottom corner.
Photo 2 shows many stacked wooden pallets in a covered yard, of mixed sizes and types.
All three photos carry the watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GOLDNEST'.
No scale, weight ticket, brand stamp, or model marking is visible in any photo.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted
claims.evidence: photos show surface appearance only; dryness and sorting cannot be confirmed remotely
moisture content inside the wood cannot be checked from photos

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning
claims.evidence: no scale or weight ticket appears in any photo

risks.risk: Pallets may be wet, rotten, or moldy inside despite looking dry on the surface
risks.proof: close-up photo of cut end grain or a moisture meter reading

risks.risk: Actual count and total weight of the lot are unknown; 500 kg may refer to one pallet or the whole stack
risks.proof: photo of the full lot on a scale with the weight display visible, or a counted stack with dimensions
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single pallet of unknown weight

risks.risk: Boards or blocks may be cracked, split, or missing
risks.proof: photos or video of all four sides and the underside of each pallet

risks.risk: The stack in photo 2 may not be the same lot as the single pallet in photos 0-1
risks.proof: video showing the seller's full stock and the specific pallets for sale
risks.if_unproven: priced based only on the single pallet shown in photos 0-1

proof_requests: Photo of the pallets on a certified scale showing the total weight
Close-up photos of pallet ends and undersides to check for rot or breaks
Video or photo showing the full quantity being sold
response.reason: The item is clearly a wooden pallet, so it can be priced at its worst case; unverified claims about weight, dryness, and quantity are treated as unproven and priced down.
